sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:1

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:1:1
items.html: It rolls and descends to the lower chamber, etc.: The matter of the three chambers has already been clarified in the previous part: that the lower chamber is the phase of Nefesh, and the middle one is the phase of Ruach, and the upper one is the phase of GAR — for the fetus is not completed in the NRNHY of Nefesh, but rather by way of its ascent through them, up to the upper chamber — study it there well. However, at the time of birth, it loses all the high degrees of the Ibur, and it descends completely from the phase of Atzilut and descends to BYA, as is written before us. And this is what he means: “when the time of birth arrives, it rolls and descends to the lower chamber” — that is, it then loses the entire NRNHY of the Ibur; as he concludes, “and afterward it comes out even from that lower chamber” — that is, it also loses the phase of the Nefesh of Atzilut, which is the phase of the lower chamber, as above, and descends to BYA. As is written before us.
